steps.note: The fat is melted first, since solid fat or fat added to a cold base emulsifies badly.

steps.what: melted anhydrous milk fat, into skimmed milk powder dissolved in water
steps.note: A high-shear mixer turns the fat into an emulsion in the water and powder base.
Where the mixing leaves the emulsion fine enough, homogenising is left to the heat treatment that follows.

processing.text: For long life it is heated by UHT instead, indirectly at 138 to 140 °C for 4 s.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook: Recombined milk products

sources.text: The temperatures, the order of melting, mixing and heat treatment, and the UHT alternative, from this chapter; it gives no homogenising pressure.
